# Crystal Plastic Hair Claw Clips for Fine to Medium Hair

Keep your hair secure all day with these women's crystal plastic hair claws. This 8-piece set gives you a reliable clip for every day, whether you're styling a top knot, pinning back loose strands, or holding your hair up in the shower.

## Features That Hold Your Hair in Place

Interlocking teeth and strong claws grip the hair firmly, so the clip stays where you put it. Each claw measures 1.38 inches long and 1.38 inches wide, with a compact 0.99-inch height that suits a range of hairstyles. The durable plastic construction is built for regular use.

## Benefits for Your Daily Routine

Skip the frustration of slipping pins. These clips help you secure fine or thin hair without tugging, making it easier to wear protective and up-do styles. Pinning hair up before a shower keeps it dry and out of the way, and the set's compact size makes it simple to carry in a bag or keep in a drawer.

## Versatile Enough for Any Setting

Use these claws at home, in the dorm, at the salon, or in the kitchen. They work well for securing loose hair while you cook, clean, or get ready for the day.

## Value Packed for Everyday Use

Eight clips in one set gives you a backup for every hairstyle and every bag. At $5.99, this set is an affordable way to stock up on a hair accessory you'll reach for often.

Add these hair claws to your cart today and find a clip that keeps your hair put.
